2117427261813010608.en_summary: @amitisinvesting praises $PLTR's exceptional quarter with 96% revenue growth and 62% adjusted operating income margins. US commercial revenue surpassed US government revenue for the first time, with 148% YoY US commercial growth, 165% net dollar retention and 158% rule of 40. Stock is down due to macro and midterms, but core business is growing faster and more profitably than ever, with adjusted FCF in 90 days equal to early last year's revenue.
2117427261813010608.zh_summary: @amitisinvesting 讚揚 $PLTR 出色的季度業績，收入增長 96%，調整後營業收入利潤率 62%。美國商業收入首次超過美國政府收入，美國商業同比增長 148%，淨美元留存率 165%，Rule of 40 達 158%。股價因宏觀因素和中期選舉下跌，但核心業務增長速度和盈利能力前所未有，90 天調整後自由現金流已相當於去年初的收入。

2117427229202190601.en_summary: @amitisinvesting reports $GRAB's exceptional Q3 with $1.12B revenue (first billion dollar quarter), 57M monthly users (fastest QoQ growth since 2022), 21% EBITDA margins (highest ever, up 565 bps YoY), raised EBITDA guide to 60% YoY growth, adjusted FCF $533M doubling YoY, financial services now profitable and $400M buyback. At 11B market cap with 5B cash, doing $4.2B revenue and growing bottom line 60%. Meta chose Grab as one of the first partners for Muse in Singapore. Network effects compounding with operating leverage, oil has been the headwind.
2117427229202190601.zh_summary: @amitisinvesting 報告 $GRAB 出色的第三季業績，收入 11.2 億美元（首個十億美元季度），月活躍用戶 5700 萬（2022 年以來最快季度增長），EBITDA 利潤率 21%（歷史最高，同比上升 565 個基點），上調 EBITDA 指引至同比增長 60%，調整後自由現金流 5.33 億美元同比翻倍，金融服務已盈利並回購 4 億美元。市值 110 億美元，現金 50 億美元，收入 42 億美元，底線增長 60%。Meta 選擇 Grab 作為新加坡 Muse 的早期合作夥伴之一。網絡效應與營運槓桿複合，油價為逆風。

2117427200932659651.en_summary: Market recap: $PLTR extraordinary Q3 2026 revenue +96% YoY to record $2.31B, US commercial +148% to $984M surpassing government, Rule of 40 158%, raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $8.53B (+91%). $META targeting at least $20B bond offering, $ORCL preparing nearly $10B equity at about 11% discount plus bonds for AI infrastructure. $GRAB Q3 revenue +27% to $1.11B, adj EBITDA +73% to record $237M, raised guidance. Trump and Vance optimistic on potential US-Iran deal, which has contributed to falling oil prices.
2117427200932659651.zh_summary: 市場總結：$PLTR 非凡的 2026 年第三季，收入同比增長 96% 至紀錄的 23.1 億美元，美國商業收入增長 148% 至 9.84 億美元超過政府收入，Rule of 40 達 158%，上調 2026 財年收入指引至 85.3 億美元（+91%）。$META 目標至少 200 億美元債券發行，$ORCL 準備近 100 億美元股權發行（約 11% 折讓）加上債券用於 AI 基建。$GRAB 第三季收入增長 27% 至 11.1 億美元，調整後 EBITDA 增長 73% 至紀錄的 2.37 億美元，上調指引。特朗普和萬斯對潛在美伊協議持樂觀態度，有助油價下跌。
